title: citations file
body:
- [x] follow-up to #80

This adds a `CITATION.cff` file, together with a `pre-commit` hook that validates it. Note that this is an initial draft, so feel free to suggest changes.
diff:
diff --git a/.pre-commit-config.yaml b/.pre-commit-config.yaml
index 9661511d..39e54e08 100644
--- a/.pre-commit-config.yaml
+++ b/.pre-commit-config.yaml
@@ -27,6 +27,10 @@ repos:
       - id: blackdoc
         additional_dependencies: ["black==24.10.0"]
       - id: blackdoc-autoupdate-black
+  - repo: https://github.com/citation-file-format/cffconvert
+    rev: b6045d78aac9e02b039703b030588d54d53262ac
+    hooks:
+      - id: validate-cff
   - repo: https://github.com/kynan/nbstripout
     rev: 0.7.1
     hooks:
diff --git a/CITATION.cff b/CITATION.cff
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..44ee68c3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/CITATION.cff
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+cff-version: 1.2.0
+title: xdggs
+message: "If you use this software, please cite it as below."
+type: software
+authors:
